dod_anzio.notes: The one reviewed reference. It leads the queue for that reason, not for play volume -- three maps are played more.

dod_lennon5_b1.notes: Most-played map in the pool. It sat here as `dod_lennon_test`, a name no map carries, and the topology claim filed under that name is dropped rather than inherited. Geometry, weights and waypoints unreviewed.

dod_armory_b7.notes: Second-most-played map, and missing from this queue entirely until discovery stopped keying on the config say line. Listed as dod_armory_b6 until the pool moved to b7. Nothing reviewed.

dod_harrington.notes: Flag weights must reflect its non-linear first/second layout; bot waypoints are not verified.

dod_saints2_b5e.notes: It sat here as `dod_saints`, a stock map that is not in the pool, so the linear-topology claim filed under that name is dropped rather than inherited. Listed as dod_saints2_b3e until the pool moved to b5e. It is also the only pool map whose BSP authors home flags, so its review cannot assume a neutral-open board.

dod_thunder2.notes: Overview transform is on disk and its provenance is settled -- every field matches the map's own shipped overviews/dod_thunder2.txt, and it is not inherited from dod_donner despite the donner flag names. Flags, topology and waypoints are still unreviewed.
